scenario: Completed ten-second synthetic planner request followed by Home, foreground activation and exact draft continuation

observations: Main-thread activity outside the idle run loop primarily served accessibility snapshots.
The UIKit animation manager thread was waiting in AnimationKit.
No busy JavaScript or main-thread PDF engine loop was observed in this short sample.

runner.observation: The sample captured result assertions and accessibility queries after the first animation wait; it does not profile the entire wait.

limits: Sampling is diagnostic evidence, not proof that every frame or input was responsive.
The baseline test contains two approximately sixty-second XCTest animation waits and fails its cancellation-counter assertion; it is not an accepted fast-resume test.
The counter error was independently traced to a synthetic provider listener that remained registered after successful completion.
